title: Apps-Hub — index of the GenesisAeon interactive sandbox series
description: A single hub linking all live GenesisAeon interactive physics sandboxes and the package catalog: Klimakatalog, AMOC-Kipppunkt, Amazonas-Kipppunkt, Meereis-Albedo-Sandbox, Gamma-Explorer, Wolken, Kaskaden-Sandbox, Korallen-DHW-Sandbox, Klimasensitivität-Sandbox, Ozeanversauerung-Sandbox, Wildfire-Flood-Cascade-Sandbox, Permafrost-Sandbox, Gletscher-Puffer-Sandbox, River-Gauge-Shipping-Sandbox, Peatland-Rewetting-Sandbox, and Urban-Heat-Island-Sandbox. Each sandbox ports real, verified equations and coefficients from its underlying GenesisAeon science package -- no invented numbers, no UTAC/CREP/AFET overlay unless the package itself has one. Does not replace the Klimakatalog; indexes the interactive apps built on top of it. Part of the GenesisAeon ecosystem.
